CDC-CI Capital, the investment arm of Cote d'Ivoire's public deposit and consignment fund, put CFA720 million (USD 1.2 million) in seed grants into eight local start-ups, announced 2026-05-27 (Launch Base Africa); named tech recipients are Ecole Pay and ADES (CFA100 million each) and Flot (CFA65 million), and the fund is largely financed by the World Bank. The financier is Ivorian.
CDC-CI Capital, an Ivorian public-fund investment arm, committed CFA800 million to the fintech Djamo in July 2025, per Launch Base Africa.
